name: Barrow Duellist
languages: Understands Common plus one other language but can't speak

Actions.name: Multiattack
Actions.text: The duellist makes two attacks, using Greatsword or Hurled Debris in any combination.

Actions.name: Greatsword
Actions.text: *Melee Attack Roll:* +7, reach 5 ft. 14 (3d6 + 4) Slashing damage plus 7 (2d6) Necrotic damage. If the duellist moved at least 20 feet straight toward the target immediately before the hit and the target is Large or smaller, the target has the Prone condition, and the duellist can make one Greatsword attack against it as a Bonus Action.

Actions.name: Hurled Debris
Actions.text: *Ranged Attack Roll:* +7, range 60/240 ft. 18 (4d6 + 4) Slashing damage.

Traits.name: Sockets Locked
Traits.text: While the duellist is moving toward a creature it has damaged within the last 24 hours, the duellist's Speed can't be reduced and Difficult Terrain doesn't cost it extra movement.

Traits.name: Great Weapon Master
Traits.text: When the duellist hits a creature with its Greatsword, the attack deals an extra 3 damage.

lore: Raised from a forgotten battlefield by a necromancer who needed a blade that would never tire, it keeps its greatsword and seeks only the next fight to finish, forever replaying the last order it understood: keep the line.

generation.cite: composition after Hill Giant (CR 5) — two of the same swing, thrown rock
